name: Fluxserp – AI Content Writer & SEO on Autopilot
author: fluxserp

sections.description:
Fluxserp Integration connects your WordPress site to Fluxserp — an AI-powered content platform that generates and schedules SEO-optimized articles.

The plugin automatically syncs articles from your Fluxserp account and publishes or saves them as posts in WordPress.
Each sync checks today plus a recent catch-up window so articles missed on previous days can still be imported automatically.

Supports:
– HTML-ready content (converted from Markdown)
– Featured images (auto sideload)
– SEO meta (Yoast SEO & Rank Math)
– Custom slugs and metadata
– Duplicate prevention

Key Features

  • Automatic hourly sync via WP-Cron with backlog catch-up
  • Manual “Sync Now” trigger
  • Draft or Publish mode
  • Recent content queue visibility
  • Secure Integration Key (encrypted storage)

How It Works

  1. Create an integration in your Fluxserp dashboard
  2. Copy your Integration Key
  3. Install and activate the plugin
  4. Paste the key in Admin → Fluxserp
  5. Choose publish mode (Draft or Publish)

Articles will sync automatically.

Requirements

  • Active Fluxserp subscription
  • WordPress 5.8+
  • PHP 8.0+
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Integration Key?

From your Fluxserp dashboard → Settings → Integrations.

How often does it sync?

Automatically every hour via WP-Cron, or manually via “Sync Now”. Each run checks today’s queue and the previous 7 days by default.

Can I review articles before publishing?

Yes. Set mode to “Draft” in plugin settings.

Will it import duplicates?

No. Each article is uniquely tracked and imported once.

Does it support SEO plugins?

Yes. Compatible with Yoast SEO and Rank Math.
